# Upload marker format

Every episode Kapto uploads ends with `_SUCCESS` in its folder at
the destination: each object of the episode there with its size and
SHA-256. Format `kapto.upload`, version 1.

## Completeness rule

Storage can't make several objects appear at once, so an episode's
files become visible one by one while it is uploaded. An uploaded
episode is complete only when all of these hold:

1. Its folder holds `_SUCCESS`. Kapto writes it last, once every
   file is up and verified, so a folder without it is still arriving
   or was interrupted: leave it alone.
2. `_SUCCESS` has format `kapto.upload`.
3. Each object it lists is in the folder with its listed size and
   SHA-256. The list holds the files of the episode's
   [manifest](manifest.md) and `manifest.json` itself.

Kapto writes the marker only if none is there, so an uploaded episode
is never overwritten; uploading it again finds the marker and stops.
Paths use `/` between folders and are sorted. New versions only add
fields; a reader that finds a version newer than it knows treats the
marker as unreadable rather than guess.

## JSON Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "UploadMarker",
  "description": "An uploaded episode: every object of it at its destination.",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "episode": {
      "description": "The episode's ID.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "files": {
      "description": "Every object of the episode beside the marker, sorted by path: the\nfiles the manifest lists, and `manifest.json` itself.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/FileEntry"
      }
    },
    "format": {
      "description": "Always `\"kapto.upload\"`.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "kapto_version": {
      "description": "The Kapto version that uploaded it.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "robot": {
      "description": "The ID of the robot package it was recorded with, if any.",
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "uploaded_utc_ns": {
      "description": "When the upload was complete, in UTC nanoseconds since the Unix\nepoch.",
      "type": "integer",
      "format": "int64"
    },
    "version": {
      "description": "The format version; versions only ever add fields.",
      "type": "integer",
      "format": "uint32",
      "minimum": 0
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "format",
    "version",
    "episode",
    "kapto_version",
    "uploaded_utc_ns",
    "files"
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "FileEntry": {
      "description": "One file of an episode.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "bytes": {
          "description": "The file's size in bytes.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "path": {
          "description": "The path from the episode folder, with `/` between folders.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "sha256": {
          "description": "The SHA-256 of the file's contents, as 64 lowercase hex digits.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "path",
        "bytes",
        "sha256"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
